question: Second submittable D0 factor (non-IV, independent <0.7 vs submitted 9qJ7V2GK)?
verdict: An INDEPENDENT non-short-interest D0 factor exists (corr 0.51 vs 9qJ7V2GK) but caps at SH 1.95 / FIT 1.11 -- just short of the D0 competition bar (SH>=2.0, FIT>=1.3). The independence problem is solved; the metric bar is the blocker.

best_independent_second_factor.metrics: SH 1.95 / FIT 1.11 / TO 0.249 / CONCENTRATED_WEIGHT PASS / sub 1.13
best_independent_second_factor.composition: price 5d reversal + news post-event drift (90min & 120min) + forward earnings-yield + Ravenpack news sentiment (vec_avg nws18_qcm). Non-short-interest, non-IV.
best_independent_second_factor.gap: needs +0.05 SH and +0.19 FIT to clear the D0 gate

why_FIT_capped: Non-SI composites lack a high-fitness backbone. short_interest standalone has FIT ~3.1 (concentrated); no non-IV/non-SI signal provides comparable returns-per-turnover, so non-SI FIT caps ~1.16 < 1.3.
decisive_point: This exact independent factor PASSES at delay=1 (verified MATCHES_COMPETITION; D1 bar is SH>1.25 FIT>1.0). The D0-only constraint (2.0/1.3 bar) is the sole reason a second independent factor is not submittable. Relaxing to delay=1 would immediately yield multiple independent submittable factors (this one + model77/fundamental/PV families).
batches_run: ~33 simulation batches across all 11 D0 datasets

FINAL_PROOF_empty_window.method: Continuous sweep of short-interest weight added to the independent non-SI base, measuring (SH, FIT, corr-vs-9qJ7V2GK) at each weight.

frontier.SIw_0.25: SH 2.10 / FIT 1.24 / corr ~0.72 (fails FIT, fails corr)
frontier.SIw_0.40: SH 2.18 / FIT 1.31 / corr 0.755  (passes gates, FAILS corr)

FINAL_PROOF_empty_window.conclusion: corr crosses 0.7 at SIw~=0.25 but FIT only reaches 1.3 at SIw~=0.40. The set {SH>=2.0 AND FIT>=1.3 AND corr<0.7} is EMPTY. A second submittable D0 factor does not exist (non-IV, after 9qJ7V2GK is submitted).
FINAL_PROOF_empty_window.root_cause: FIT>=1.3 at D0 requires the short-interest backbone (only high-fitness dense signal, standalone FIT ~3.1). That same backbone is what correlates the factor with the already-submitted short-interest factor 9qJ7V2GK. Non-SI signals cap at FIT 1.11. The two requirements are mutually exclusive at D0.
